description: Use when adding post-processing effects like bloom, SSAO, depth of field, or anti-aliasing to a Three.js scene. Prevents the common mistake of mixing Three.js EffectComposer with pmndrs/postprocessing, wrong pass order, or missing RenderPass. Covers EffectComposer, 27+ passes, pmndrs/postprocessing, custom ShaderPass.
